name: CombineColumnsNode
label: Combine Columns
description: Merges the values of multiple columns into a single column, separated by a delimiter. The original columns can be removed or kept.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to combine columns from.

fields.name: ColumnsToCombine
fields.label: Columns To Combine
fields.description: Comma-separated column names to merge into one column, in order.

fields.name: Delimiter
fields.label: Delimiter
fields.description: The separator placed between combined values. Defaults to a single space.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the combined column. Defaults to 'Combined'.

fields.name: RemoveSourceColumns
fields.label: Remove Source Columns
fields.description: True to remove the source columns after combining. Defaults to false.

fields.name: SkipEmptyValues
fields.label: Skip Empty Values
fields.description: True to skip null/empty source values when combining. Defaults to false.
